remarks: This very affordable quiet spacious 1 bdr unit is in the heart of historic Norwalk and close to the beach, Westport border, shops, SONO, the Merritt, I-95 and a Train Station. Wake up by the bells from the two churches built in 16th and 17th century. Relax in the park and gazebo across the building or stroll to Stew Leonard's for a cone of frozen yogurt. The condo has just been painted in crispy white, it has a brand new carpet and it's in an immaculate condition. Plenty of free parking. Make an appointment before this rare unit is gone.
